September 30, 2026 / 1:33 PM EDT / CBS News On Tuesday at the Make America Healthy Again summit, Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. said that artificial intelligence can give patients "a second opinion that is much better informed than any doctor in the country." He said it has the power to "free us from medical tyranny." He also said public officials who tell Americans to defer to experts will "never ever again" be able to dominate them: "If somebody tells you that a vaccine will prevent transmission and infection, or you need to take it to protect your grandmother, A.I. may say it actually doesn't do that." The same day, the White House launched America.gov . It promises "simple answers only from official government sources." Its health answers cite agencies Kennedy runs: the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the Food and Drug Administration, the National Institutes of Health, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services. items.text: Manchester Half Marathon 2026: Start times, route map, road closures and everything you need to know
items.article: More than 32,000 people will be taking part in the athletic feat The Manchester Half Marathon will take place this weekend and will see tens of thousands of people attempt to reach their personal best for charities close to their heart. First held in the city back in 2016, the Manchester Half has gone on to become one of the city's biggest events and sees thousands of people line the streets as they cheer on people from all over the world as they tackle the mighty 13.1 mile course. It's estimated that 32,000 people will be taking on the half this year, which is a big increase on the 22,500 that are understood to have taken part last year and raised over £1.8m for local and national charities. This year's event will, once again, start and end in Old Trafford with the full route taking in the sights of the likes of Chorlton, Sale and Stretford. Along the route, both participants and spectators will be able to enjoy a series of 'cheer zones' as well as live DJs amping up the vibes. Organisers have said that participants this year will be raising money for the likes of Alder Hey Children's Charity, Samaritans, Mencap, the Lancashire Cricket Foundation, Mustard Tree, and the British Heart Foundation, as well as local organisations and charities. If you're planning on watching all of the action, or even take part in it yourself, we've rounded up all the key details including timings, locations, the route map, road closures, bag drops and the best viewing spots.

items.article: My Sad Dead is about an Argentinian doctor who can speak with ghosts. The Spanish-language miniseries blends creepiness, melancholy, sarcastic humor and political anger unlike anything else on TV. Mercedes Morán stars as Ema, an antisocial doctor who can see and communicate with ghosts. Netflix hide caption Even if you don't believe in them, ghost stories are eerie. They take place on the threshold between our daily world and a mysteriously unknown realm. Now, many movies and books cross this threshold merely to scare the bejeezus out of us. But the greatest ghost stories aim to do something more — such as capturing the weight of Mexico's past like Juan Rulfo's Pedro Páramo , or exploring one's own madness, as Stanley Kubrick does in his adaptation of Stephen King 's much saner The Shining . You find that brand of ambition in My Sad Dead , a new Spanish-language Netflix series centering on a woman who can see and talk to ghosts. Weaving together three short stories by Mariana Enriquez , who's been dubbed "the sorceress of Buenos Aires horror," this four-part show was directed by Pablo Larraín , the Chilean filmmaker who's best known here for movies about Jackie O, starring Natalie Portman , and Lady Di, starring Kristen Stewart . But Larraín's always at his best closer to home, and here he's made a show whose blend of creepiness, melancholy, sarcastic humor and political anger is unlike anything else on TV. items.article: As Brock Purdy has looked like an MVP candidate this season, the 49ers could set a sky-high trade price for backup quarterback Mac Jones. When the San Francisco 49ers take the field on Sunday against the Denver Broncos, most of the focus will naturally be on starting quarterback Brock Purdy, who will try to get his team to a 4-0 start. But in front offices around the league, all eyes have been on the Niners quarterback who’s spent more time on the sideline than under center this season: Mac Jones, who is now back in the NFL trade rumor mill . After just three weeks, a handful of teams have already dealt with their starting quarterbacks missing time due to injury. The variance in talent among starters can be pretty stark on its own, but at the second-string level, it gets even wider. Sometimes a second-stringer can pull a Case Keenum, who dominated the Eagles on primetime with 247 yards and three total touchdowns. Oftentimes, however, the game plan with a backup under center is to put him in a position so he doesn’t royally screw things up. Take the New York Giants, where starter Jaxson Dart is out for the season and backup Jameis Winston threw for just 118 yards in an ugly 12-7 win against the lowly Titans. (Perhaps unsurprisingly, the Giants traded a fifth-rounder to Minnesota for former first-round pick J.J. McCarthy one day after that game.) items.text: Is this the best housing market for buyers in years?
items.article: New Zealand’s housing market has taken another step backwards. But it’s a small step. Cotality NZ’s latest Home Value Index (HVI) recorded a -0.3% fall in... New Zealand’s housing market has taken another step backwards. But it’s a small step. Cotality NZ’s latest Home Value Index (HVI) recorded a -0.3% fall in September, marking the sixth consecutive monthly decline. National property values are now -1.3% lower than a year ago, with the median value slipping to $797,078, below the previous cycle low recorded in June 2023. While buyers have more choice and bargaining power, there’s still little sign of a sharp rebound. But Cotality NZ chief property economist Kelvin Davidson told The Front Page that the market is not in a major new downturn. “Really, if you look at property values, at least on our index and other measures as well, the downturn actually happened in 2022 and 2023. Since then, house values haven’t recovered by any means. But since that point, in sort of mid-2023, they’ve actually been pretty flat.

items.text: The world's oldest mummies are decomposing after 7,000 years. Here's why.
items.article: Here on Short Wave, we're getting into the Halloween spirit a little early with a look at the world's oldest mummies. They're found in modern-day northern Chile. The mummies are well-preserved, so over the past 7,000 years, some have been exhumed for scientific study. But recently, something startling happened: Some of the mummies started to decompose. Today on the show, Regina G. Barber talks to archeologist Marcela Sepulveda about the civilization that made these mummies: the Chinchorro people. We dig into the science behind their mummification techniques and how the changing planet is affecting archeologists' ability to study the past. Fascinated by a science mystery?
